title: Butter bean, chorizo and paprika stew
preamble:
Make it vegey by missing out the chorizo....I feel I've overstepped the line by typing something so effing obvious!!!!!
Ingredients:-
150g
chorizo
1
onion
1
garlic clove, chopped
2
teaspoons Rosemary, finely chopped
1.5
teaspoon sweet or hot smoked paprika
1
x 400g carton tomatoes
2
x 400g butter beans
230g
roasted red peppers, sliced
6
thick slices of hot buttered toast

teaspoons Rosemary, finely chopped

teaspoon sweet or hot smoked paprika
1
x 400g carton tomatoes
2
x 400g butter beans
230g
roasted red peppers, sliced
6
thick slices of hot buttered toast

Method:-
Fry chorizo til brown
Fry onion til golden
Add garlic, Rosemary, paprika and fry for another minute
Add tomato, beans and peppers.
Add 200ml water
Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes
Add chorizo and warm through and serve over toast
